paper_title: Side chain engineering of n-type conjugated polymer enhances photocurrent and efficiency of all-polymer solar cells

knowledge_points.content: The n-type conjugated random copolymers (PNDIS-xBO) are synthesized using Stille coupling of 2,5-bis(trimethylstannyl)-selenophene with two different NDI monomers: one bearing 2-decyltetradecyl (DT) side chains and another bearing 2-butyloctyl (BO) side chains.
knowledge_points.evidence: The n-type conjugated random copolymers... were synthesized by Stille coupling polymerization of three monomers... 2,5-bis(trimethylstannyl)- selenophene, 4,9-dibromo-2,7-bis(2-decyltetradecyl)benzo[lmn][3,8]- phenanthroline-1,3,6,8-tetraone (NDI-DT), and 4,9-dibromo 2,7-bis(2-butyloctyl) benzo[lmn][3,8]phenanthroline-1,3,6,8-tetraone (NDI-BO).

knowledge_points.content: An optimized all-polymer solar cell using PSEHTT:PNDIS-30BO achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 4.44% and a short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 10.37 mA cm⁻².
knowledge_points.evidence: The performance of these all-polymer solar cells is significantly improved with a PCE of 4.44%, photocurrent of 10.37 mA cm-2, and Voc of 0.77 V.

knowledge_points.content: Increasing the molar fraction of the shorter 2-butyloctyl (BO) side chain in PNDIS copolymers decreases the π–π stacking distance from 4.12 Å (0% BO) to 3.92 Å (50% BO).
knowledge_points.evidence: the π-π stacking distance was 4.12, 4.05, 3.99, 3.92 Å, respectively [for PNDIS, PNDIS-10BO, PNDIS-30BO, and PNDIS-50BO].

knowledge_points.content: The mean crystalline domain size (L) of the PNDIS-xBO polymers increases as the BO side chain content increases, ranging from 8.4 nm for PNDIS (0% BO) to 13.3 nm for PNDIS-50BO.
knowledge_points.evidence: The mean crystalline domain size L was found to be 8.4, 8.5, 8.8, and 13.3 nm for PNDIS, PNDIS-10BO, PNDIS30BO, and PNDIS-50BO, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The all-polymer solar cells utilize an inverted bulk heterojunction (BHJ) structure consisting of ITO/ZnO/polymer blend/MoO₃/Ag.
knowledge_points.evidence: The photovoltaic and charge transport properties... were investigated by inverted BHJ solar cells... The inverted device structure, ITO/ZnO/polymer blend/Mo03/Ag, used to measure photovoltaic properties.

knowledge_points.content: Surface modification of the ZnO electron-collecting electrode with 1 vol% ethanolamine in 2-methoxyethanol improves device performance by reducing the ZnO work function from 4.4 eV to 3.9 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: treatment of ZnO surface with 1 vol% ethanolamine in methoxyethanol reduced the work function of zno from 4.4 to 3.9 eV, resulting in improved performance of polymer/ fullerene solar cells.

knowledge_points.content: The solubility of PNDIS-xBO polymers in organic solvents like chloroform and chlorobenzene decreases significantly when the BO side chain content reaches 50 mol%, dropping to approximately 10 mg/mL.
knowledge_points.evidence: PNDIS, PNDIS-10BO, PNDIS-30BO showed excellent solubility (> 40 mg mL-1) in common organic solvents (chloroform, chlorobenzene) at room temperature whereas PNDIS-50BO [~10 mg mL-1] showed very limited solubility.

knowledge_points.content: External quantum efficiency (EQE) measurements reveal that the n-type PNDIS-xBO polymers contribute to light harvesting in the 500–750 nm range, where the donor polymer PSEHTT does not absorb.
knowledge_points.evidence: the n-type polymers contribute to the light harvesting since the donor polymer PSEHTT does not absorb past 700 nm... EQE spectra... show that the photoresponse begins at ~750 nm.

knowledge_points.content: PNDIS-30BO:PSEHTT blend films exhibit an electron mobility of 6.5 × 10⁻⁵ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and a hole mobility of 2.1 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, which are over twice as high as the mobilities in the reference PNDIS:PSEHTT system.
knowledge_points.evidence: Compared to the reference PSEHTT:PNDIS blend system, bulk electron and hole mobilities increased by factors of 2.2–2.5 to 6.5 × 10-5 and 2.1 × 10-4 cm2 V-1 s-1, respectively, in the PSEHTT:PNDIS-30BO blend system.

knowledge_points.content: AFM analysis shows that the PNDIS-30BO blend film possesses a smoother surface (roughness of 1.2 nm) and smaller domain sizes compared to the PNDIS-50BO blend (roughness of 3.4 nm).
knowledge_points.evidence: PNDIS-30BO blend film surface showed significantly reduced domain sizes... and small roughness of 1.2 nm... The highest roughness of 3.4 nm with higher domain size is observed in PNDIS-50BO blend films.

knowledge_points.content: The LUMO energy levels for all PNDIS-xBO variations remain constant at -3.9 eV, indicating that side chain engineering primarily affects physical packing rather than the electronic energy levels of the polymer backbone.
knowledge_points.evidence: The LUMO energy level derived from the onset reduction potential in CVs (Fig. S7, ESI†) was -3.9 eV for all the polymers.
